scope: Frozen-policy MuJoCo dynamics prediction ablation; not PPO training and not full feedback innovation validation
early_stopping_selection: minimum validation multi-step standardized state loss; same selection for all neural arms
state: 67 physical coordinates: root xyz, wxyz quaternion, 6 root velocities, 27 joint positions, 27 velocities
input: root xy zeroed for translation invariance; remaining current state, 29 actions, 2 task identity bits
targets: 67 next-state increments; quaternion renormalized after prediction
training_data_rule: reference-disjoint split; all normalization fitted only on training references; no random transition split
privacy: raw motion/state arrays and learned weights stay in ignored server artifacts; public results contain aggregate metrics, hashes and logs
